capture.summary: Major work completed on stock data synchronization system: (1) Backed up stock_realtime table and implemented atomic table swap mechanism for zero-downtime migration; (2) Created StockSyncTask scheduled job to pull stock/ETF/HK stock data from external APIs with proper code formatting (removing .SZ/.SH/.HK/.OF suffixes); (3) Fixed data consistency issues by correcting stock_trace records with invalid stock_id references using name/market matching; (4) Fixed Flutter null pointer exceptions by providing default values when baseStockInfo is missing; (5) Added HK real-time data API integration; (6) In AI developer knowledge hub project: implemented daily interview question generator with Experience Store for self-improving article quality, added quality gate (>=80 score) with judge-write loop, and state management to resume from failed stages.

analyze.day_summary: Completed major overhaul of stock data synchronization system with atomic table swap migration, integrated multi-source stock/ETF/HK stock APIs with proper data normalization, fixed data integrity issues in stock_trace table, resolved Flutter null pointer exceptions with defensive defaults, and enhanced AI knowledge hub with self-improving article generation and quality gates.
themes: Self-improving AI agents with quality scoring

highlights.title: Implemented atomic table swap for stock_realtime migration
highlights.description: Created backup table stock_realtime_bak0613 and implemented DROP/RENAME atomic swap pattern: DROP stock_realtime_bak, DROP stock_realtime_temp, CREATE temp, populate from API, RENAME stock_realtime→stock_realtime_bak and temp→stock_realtime. Ensures zero downtime during daily data sync.
highlights.impact: Zero downtime migration, ~12,000 records synced (5,533 stocks + 3,737 ETFs + 2,762 HK stocks)

highlights.title: Created StockSyncTask for multi-source stock data synchronization
highlights.description: Implemented scheduled task (cron: 0 0 9 * * ?) to fetch data from three APIs: mainland stocks (code=ALL, exchange=ALL), ETFs, and HK stocks. Fixed code formatting to remove suffixes (.SZ/.SH/.HK/.OF) and correctly assign market field (SZ/SH/HK).
highlights.impact: Automated daily sync of 12,032 securities with proper data normalization

highlights.title: stock_trace table had invalid stock_id references
highlights.description: After stock_realtime rebuild, stock_trace.stock_id contained obsolete codes with suffixes (.SZ/.SH/.OF) that no longer existed in the new stock_realtime table, causing orphaned records.
highlights.root_cause: Old data used compound code format (e.g., '000008.SZ') while new schema uses clean code with separate market field, breaking foreign key relationships.
highlights.solution: Created SQL migration script: backup stock_trace → update stock_id by cross-referencing stock_realtime_bak0613 using name+market matching to find correct codes in new stock_realtime → log unmatched records to file (HK stocks with no mapping).
highlights.impact: Repaired data integrity for historical trace records, logged unmappable entries for manual review

highlights.title: Flutter null pointer exceptions in BaseStockInfo deserialization
highlights.description: App crashed with 'type 'Null' is not a subtype of type 'String'' and 'type 'Null' is not a subtype of type 'Map<String, dynamic>'' when accessing baseStockInfo fields in TraceList and HomeBindDialogList.
highlights.root_cause: stock_realtime data was incomplete after sync - some stocks had no corresponding baseStockInfo records, causing null returns from /depth/market-stock/page and /depth/hit-stock/page APIs.
highlights.solution: Modified WatchListedClassifyInfoServiceImpl and StockRealtimeServiceImpl to provide default values: getLatestPrice returns 0.0, getChangePercent returns 0.0, and added isNotNull checks to pageListByIds to filter out incomplete records.
highlights.impact: Eliminated Flutter crashes, degraded gracefully for incomplete data

highlights.title: Integrated HK stock real-time data API
highlights.description: Added fetchAllHkStocksRealtime method calling https://s.apifox.cn/e47efd7e-6bc1-4c27-bf04-2424d843dda0/470349524e0 to fetch live HK stock data. Fixed market field assignment logic to handle edge cases where market was incorrectly set to numeric codes.
highlights.impact: HK stocks now display real-time prices in market-stock/page endpoint

highlights.title: ETF codes incorrectly stripped of .OF suffix
highlights.description: ETF codes like '000008.OF' were being processed with market='SH' instead of being handled separately, and some codes still contained suffixes after sync.
highlights.root_cause: Code suffix logic s.setMarket(code.endsWith(".SZ") ? "SZ" : "SH") didn't account for .OF case, and SUBSTRING_INDEX logic was incorrectly extracting market as code prefix.
highlights.solution: Added explicit check: code.endsWith(".OF") ? "SH" (OF funds trade on SH market). Updated sync logic to properly strip all suffixes before database insert. Documented rule in .claude file.
highlights.impact: Corrected ETF code normalization, prevented future suffix handling bugs

highlights.title: Implemented self-improving AI article generation with quality gates
highlights.description: Created daily interview question generator that: (1) generates AI interview questions based on daily content, (2) evaluates articles with judge agent scoring (threshold >= 80), (3) implements write-judge loop for quality improvement, (4) uses Experience Store to accumulate successful patterns for self-evolution, (5) implements state management to resume from failed stages (publish→generate→publish).
highlights.impact: Automated high-quality content generation with built-in quality assurance

highlights.title: Chose 9:00 AM for daily stock sync schedule
highlights.description: Set cron schedule to 0 0 9 * * ? after confirming that 8:30 AM would be too early for new IPOs and ST changes to be reflected in external APIs. 9:00 AM provides buffer for market opening updates.
highlights.rationale: Balance between data freshness (post-market opening updates) and API availability. 8:30 misses same-day changes, later times delay data availability.
highlights.tradeoffs: Later time means users can't see absolute latest pre-market data, but ensures data accuracy.

architecture_decisions.decision: Atomic table swap pattern for stock_realtime updates
architecture_decisions.context: Daily full table rebuild from external APIs with 12K+ records
architecture_decisions.rationale: DROP + RENAME is atomic in MySQL, providing zero downtime. Writing to temp table then swapping avoids read-write conflicts during long sync operations.
architecture_decisions.tradeoffs: Requires doubling storage during swap (temp table). Old data preserved in _bak table for rollback, but needs cleanup.
architecture_decisions.alternatives_considered: In-place UPDATE (too slow, locks table), incremental sync (complexity of detecting deletions/additions)

architecture_decisions.decision: Separate market field from code with suffix removal
architecture_decisions.rationale: Clean codes without suffixes are better as primary keys. Market field provides clear categorization for queries and display.
architecture_decisions.tradeoffs: Requires careful suffix parsing logic. Historical data migration needed. Foreign key relationships require mapping.
architecture_decisions.alternatives_considered: Keep full code as PK (messy joins), use composite key (more complex queries)

architecture_decisions.decision: Judge-write loop with Experience Store for AI article quality
architecture_decisions.context: Need consistently high-quality generated articles without manual review
architecture_decisions.rationale: Automated quality gate (80+ score) ensures only acceptable content is published. Experience Store accumulates successful patterns, enabling progressive improvement over time.
architecture_decisions.tradeoffs: Added latency due to multiple generation attempts. Initial quality may be low until Experience Store builds up patterns.
architecture_decisions.alternatives_considered: Single generation with human review (doesn't scale), fixed templates (limited creativity)

key_insights: Atomic database migrations using temp tables and RENAME operations provide zero downtime for large-scale data refreshes, critical for production systems with 99%+ uptime requirements.

When normalizing data from external APIs (removing suffixes), always create a migration strategy for dependent tables using stable identifiers like name+market rather than volatile codes that may change format.
Default values in API responses are better than nulls for mobile clients - they prevent crashes while allowing graceful degradation when data is incomplete.
Self-improving AI systems need both a feedback loop (judge-write) and persistent knowledge storage (Experience Store) to actually improve over time, not just retry randomly.
Documenting data transformation rules (e.g., suffix handling) in project .claude files prevents recurring bugs and serves as team knowledge base.

write_judge_loop.title: 构建自我进化的 AI 写手系统：在内容生成中引入 Judge-Write 循环与经验存储
write_judge_loop.summary: 本文深入解析了一套基于 Judge-Write 循环和 Experience Store 的自我进化 AI 写手系统。针对传统 LLM 生成质量不稳定的问题，通过引入自动化的 Judge Agent 评分机制（Score>=80），并结合向量数据库存储历史成功与失败模式，实现了系统的自我迭代。文章详细对比了 Before/After 的代码实现，解析了冷启动、Token 成本及死循环风险等生产环境挑战，为构建高质量自动化内容生成系统提供了实战参考。

versions.title: Building a Self-Evolving AI Writer: Implementing the Judge-Write Loop
如何让 AI 学会自我进化？我们构建了一个带“记忆”的写手系统
versions.content:
在这个领域摸爬滚打多年，我见过太多所谓的“自动化”系统，最后都变成了需要人工持续伺候的“累赘”。

今天想和大家聊聊我们刚刚落地的一套 AI 文章生成系统。它不仅仅是一个能写东西的工具，而是一个能通过自我评判和经验积累，不断进化的 Agent 系统。

### 1. 痛点：AI 写的东西，总是差点意思

我们的需求很明确：基于每天的技术日志，自动生成深度的技术文章。

刚开始做的时候，思路很简单：给 LLM 一个 Prompt，它吐出一篇文章，发布。大功告成？

现实很快给了我们一记耳光。生成的内容质量极不稳定。有时候写得很深，有时候却变成了流水账，评分经常在 60-70 分徘徊。

这很致命，因为我们的读者是准备面试的高级工程师。低质量的输出会直接摧毁信任度。

为什么会这样？

因为这是一个“开环”系统。AI 写完就结束了，它不知道哪里写得好，哪里写得烂。下次再写，它依然是在“盲猜”你会喜欢什么。

### 2. 破局：引入“裁判”和“记忆”

为了解决“不稳定”的问题，我们引入了一套新机制：**Judge-Write 循环** + **经验存储**。

简单来说，就是在“写手”旁边，加了一个“裁判”，还有一个用来记笔记的“小本子”。

整个流程是这样的：

1.  **Writer Agent（写手）**：先去翻翻“小本子”，看看以前写好文章时用了什么技巧，或者以前犯过什么错。
2.  **写稿子**：结合这些经验生成初稿。
3.  **Judge Agent（裁判）**：给初稿打分并写评语。
4.  **决策**：
    *   如果分数超过 80 分：**发布**！并把这次成功的经验记到“小本子”上。
    *   如果分数不及格：**重写**！并把失败的原因记下来，避免下次再犯。

### 3. 这里的“小本子”是什么？

这个“小本子”就是我们说的 Experience Store。它不是一个普通的数据库，我们存进去的不是整篇文章，而是“模式”。

比如，某次我们写了一篇 95 分的高分文章，系统会自动提取出这样的模式：

*   *成功要素*：“在分析原因时，使用 Mermaid 流程图展示失败路径。”
*   *适用场景*：“数据同步故障”

等到下次再遇到类似的“数据同步故障”时，系统会自动把这个“成功要素”喂给 AI，提醒它：嘿，这次记得画个图，这样分数会高哦！

这就像带徒弟，不是让他每天瞎摸索，而是先让他读一读过去两年的“最佳实践文档”。

### 4. 上线后的“坑”与“惊喜”

这套系统上线后，效果很明显，但也踩了一些坑，分享给大家避雷：

*   **冷启动问题**：一开始“小本子”是空的，AI 没经验可抄。这时候必须人工手动塞进去一些高质量范文作为“种子数据”，帮它起个头。

*   **成本问题**：加了个“裁判”，每次生成的成本确实增加了（毕竟要多读一遍文章）。但这比因为发烂文章导致读者取关要划算得多。

*   **死循环风险**：有时候 AI 很倔，怎么写都不及格。所以我们设置了硬性的“最多重试 3 次”。如果 3 次都不行，就报警让人工来接手，别在那浪费钱了。

### 5. 总结一下

这套系统目前运行得很稳，不仅解放了编辑团队，更重要的是，随着时间的推移，它越来越“懂”我们要什么样的文章了。

这就给我们两个启发：

1.  **没有反馈，就没有进化**。任何自动化系统，如果不告诉它好坏，它永远无法自我优化。
2.  **存“模式”比存“数据”更重要**。只有学会了抽象的方法论，AI 才能举一反三，而不是只会照抄昨天的历史。

这就是 Agent 架构的魅力——它不仅是工具，更是能随时间成长的数字员工。
